trailhead.label: Staben railway station, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
The Sonnenberg is dry, south-facing steppe: very hot in summer, go early and bring water.
About 60 m on the main road and lanes in Staben and Tschars: lead on.
Orchards and vineyards beside the path are farmed and closed to dogs in Kastelbell-Tschars: keep to the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
